detail.longDescription:
Save the world in style.
Join over 20 million players in the ultimate spy adventure! Dash, dodge, and blast your way through high-stakes missions in this fast-paced action runner from the creators of Flick Golf, Blocky Football, and Blocky Pirates.

Your mission, should you choose to accept it...
Play as the daring Agent Dash, Her Majesty the Queen, or a lineup of suave heroes and dastardly villains. Race through secret lairs, volcano bases, and collapsing cities as you take down the evil Dr. Quantumfinger.

Gadgets, Explosions, Mayhem.
Equip jetpacks, deploy cloaking devices, and even slow down time! Unlock and upgrade your arsenal to survive laser traps, lava pits, and enemy agents.

Stylish, Cinematic Action.
With slick controls, gorgeous visuals, and audio inspired by classic spy movies, Agent Dash brings blockbuster energy to your fingertips.

Why you’ll love it:
- Intuitive tap-and-swipe gameplay
- Huge cast of characters and outfits
- Dynamic levels full of traps and surprises
- Upgradeable gadgets and power-ups
- Achievements, leaderboards, and endless action

Play offline anytime, anywhere

“The pinnacle of the genre” – Pocket Gamer
“The visuals are incredibly vibrant” – AppSpy
“The design is impeccable” – App Advice
